title: 借光岛 / Borrowed Light Island
notes: All models original, procedurally authored in Blender.
Lamp heads and light beams intentionally supplied by Unity.
Cabin_ReadingWindow_Glow is separately named for runtime material control.
FBX/GLB retain named component meshes and anchor empties.
Anchors, route corridors, buildings and interaction footprints remain Y=0; planted banks have smooth -3.5cm to +11.5cm humps.
revision: world-v5-r1: local boulder/plant intersection cleanup and uniform stone material assignment
design_changes: Existing stepping-stone positions and footprints retained with a shallow curved crown and worn double shoulder. All components remain closed shared topology.

Four rounded weathered boulders sit outside route corridors in one Garden_HeroBoulders mesh. Shape unchanged in r1; hard-edged BI_moss patches replaced by the corresponding warm/slate stone material, letting Unity PaintedSurface provide soft moss.
BL_FoliageTint vertex colors grade existing blades from approximately 0.78 at roots to 1.0 at tips. Other meshes are white. No added vegetation geometry or materials.

Existing layout, all 14 anchors, cabin, lamps, targets and spawn remain unchanged. Only plant components inside the actual new boulders vertical footprints are removed, after complete generation/coloring so other plants retain positions and colors. No new textures; ground textures regenerate identically to world-v4-r1.
33 coincident duplicate triangles in legacy flower poles are removed before interchange export; zero-area triangles are also checked. Maximum total budget remains 400000 triangles.
preview_scope: Low-sample Blender ground-detail inspection only. Actual Unity runtime appearance must be checked after integration.
